program.help:
Remove electrically uniform noise events from spike data.
Examines every spikeDetection group and removes spike-shaped waveforms that are nearly identical across all channels — the hallmark of electrical interference rather than genuine neural activity.
Must run AFTER ndm_extractspikes (requires .res and .spk files) and BEFORE ndm_pca / ndm_klustakwik.
Original .res and .spk files are copied to <session>_denoise_backup/ before modification.
DETECTION METHOD
For each waveform the spatial uniformity score is computed: 1. Remove DC per channel. 2. For every sample time, compute the standard deviation across channels. 3. Divide the mean of those per-sample stds by the overall RMS.
Score ≈ 0 → all channels look the same → noise event (removed). Score ≈ 1 → channels are maximally diverse → genuine spike (kept).
Spikes with score below uniformityThreshold are removed. Spikes whose peak amplitude is below minAmplitude are retained without scoring (too quiet to classify reliably).
PARAMETERS
# uniformityThreshold
Spatial uniformity score below which a waveform is classified as uniform noise and removed. Increase to remove more events (default 0.30).
# minAmplitude
Minimum peak ADC count needed to attempt scoring. Spikes quieter than this are never removed regardless of their uniformity score. Set to 0 to score all spikes (default 0 — disabled).
# removeFlat
Set to 1 to also remove waveforms with near-zero AC energy after DC subtraction (flat-line artefacts). Set to 0 only if you want to inspect flat events in Klusters before discarding them (default 1 — recommended).
# dryRun
Set to 1 to report which spikes would be removed without modifying any files. Useful for tuning uniformityThreshold (default 0).
